COMMON QUESTIONS

Good questions lead to better projects.

Can you improve an existing online store? +

Yes. We can review the current experience, identify the largest sources of friction and plan targeted improvements or a rebuild.

Can an e-commerce site connect with our business systems? +

We can assess connections to inventory, order management, ERP or CRM systems and recommend a practical integration plan.

Do you work with B2B commerce? +

Yes. B2B purchasing often needs tailored catalogues, account permissions, quote workflows or repeat ordering.
